profile.headline: Front End Software Engineer at Amazon Web Services (AWS)
profile.summary:
Professional in the software industry,  I am passionate about clean and innovative code. I seek to impact society through the development of excellent software with real world functionality. With a keen aptitude for creativity, leadership, and problem solving, I hope to be an integral part of the betterment of local and global communities.

My Beliefs:

Collaboration over Competition
- The most effective engineering culture is one of mentorship, trust, accountability and support. The most valuable engineer isn't always the smartest engineer.

Purpose
- An excellent organization is fueled by purpose. The company who prioritizes the common good will always go the farthest.

Avoid Technical Debt Like the Plague
- Do the hard thing up front and manage complexity, even if it's not the easiest solution. Cutting corners will always come back to haunt you (or worse, someone else). 

Innovation and Impact
- True innovation is powered by the potential for a great impact, if that's not the case is it really worth your time?

User Centric Design
- Usability is key. If your software isn't both intuitive and delightful to use, then it probably won't be used at all.

positions.title: Front End Software Engineer
positions.description: Frontend engineer and lead maintainer for Amazon IVS console (Interactive Video Service). Continuation of the same role with the IVS team previously at Twitch, now formally moved to AWS.

positions.title: Front End Software Engineer
positions.description: Frontend engineer at Twitch working on AWS Interactive Video Service, contracted through SolidLogix

positions.title: Tech Lead
positions.description:
•Led a team of 2-3 software engineers to architect and build large features
•Worked closely with product managers and product designers to determine scope of new features
•Built out distributed systems for complex customer needs using AWS lambda and queueing services
•Lead architect of Supermove Storage - Supermove’s storage product that unblocked many new customers and enabled them to go live on the platform
•As lead engineer, I was responsible for architecting new features that other engineers would be then build and ensuring that all code met company standards for performance
•Mentored engineers via PR reviews and formal processes

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Architected large, platform defining features from the ground up within a Python, GraphQL and React
ecosystem
•Worked closely with stakeholders to determine product direction and requirements for new features
•Implementation of test driven development to drive excellence across the codebase
•Experience working in a very intense, fast paced environment
•Iterated on features based on direct feedback from customers and usage metrics
•Due in part to the features that I built, Supermove was able to close an $18M series A investment from one of the foremost VC firms in Silicon Valley

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
At UpMetrics, I work alongside a distributed team building a complex data analytics platform. UpMetrics is a powerful tool for non-profit organizations and foundations to track, collect and analyze data. The platform allows users to visualize metrics, track progress towards goals and tell their story within the impact sector. UpMetrics is the first analytics platform of its kind, allowing organizations to upload data of any structure rather than forcing a structure upon the user.

At UpMetrics I have architected several core features that have driven value directly to the business. These features include:
- UpMetrics' unique survey platform/data collection tool
- UpMetrics Stories, a solution for tracking, organizing and sharing qualitative data
- UpMetrics data integrations with Google Sheets, SurveyMonkey and more

positions.title: Fullstack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Using Fullstack JavaScript technologies to develop software solutions for the CDC in Atlanta.
Tech Stack: React, Redux, ExpressJS, MongoDB
Major contributor in the development of fullstack "from scratch" JavaScript applications for use by Bioinformatics scientists at the Center for Disease Control and around the world

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer and Front End Engineer
positions.description:
• Developing software in the IoT Lighting industry to create innovative, sustainable and
 connected solutions
• Implementation of Angular controllers, services, and custom directives to create responsive
 web applications
• Developing Full-Stack JavaScript applications with Node, React and Redux
• Familiarity with Webpack, Babel, and Gulp to simplify testing procedures
• Utilizing frameworks such as AngularJS, .NET and Xamarin to develop mobile applications
• Exemplifying learning ability by quickly developing knowledge of complex codebases
• Fixing bugs and solving problems on front end web applications
• Lead developer for an Angular based web application
• Developing mobile applications for in-house customers to simplify standard processes
• Utilizing Agile methodologies to develop quickly and efficiently. Contributing as a member
 of Scrum teams as well as participating in Kanban development
• Enrolled in Eaton’s Leadership Development Program

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Founded a competition for makers at Grove City College. 

The Maker's Competition encouraged creative thinkers, entrepreneurs and engineers to team up to create something amazing. At least one company has been formed because of the Makers comp since it's first year.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
(Formerly Fresenius Medical Care; Warrendale Facility)

•  Worked closely with Manufacturing Engineering to ensure high quality during Engineering Build and Pilot Run of a new electro-mechanical medical device
•  Interfaced with R&D Engineering to modify device designs to make product more manufacturable
•  Experience interacting with suppliers to improve out of box quality of manufacturing parts
•  Troubleshooting experience involving printed circuit board analysis as well as mechanical assembly testing
•  Redesign of assembly procedures and work instructions to create a repeatable, reliable manufacturing procedure
•  Involvement in a fast-paced, hard working team of ambitious individuals working together to achieve a common goal

volunteerExperiences.description: I visited, along with a team of other college students, incarcerated youth weekly and mentored them in positively building personal character, faith, and social interaction and responsibility.
I was paired with a college freshman to act as a mentor during his first year at school. During this time we became great friends and are still to this day.
